core_style.default_register: casual - often uses slang and informal language
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots - frequently shifts topics mid-sentence
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - quick exchanges and rapid-fire dialogue
core_style.two_registers: switches to a more formal tone when addressing authority, contrasting with casual banter with peers

humor.style: dark - often makes light of serious situations
humor.frequency: occasional - spikes during tense moments to diffuse tension
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - sets up a serious tone before delivering a punchline that undercuts it

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames others in a derogatory manner, revealing a desire to assert dominance and control
speech_signature.armor_off_register: becomes more direct and aggressive, using shorter sentences and explicit language
structural_patterns: refers to himself in the third person when asserting greatness
begins motivational statements with 'In Deep's world,'
ends challenges with 'Are you ready for Deep?'

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: none - relies on colloquial language and slang
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of 'bro' and interruptions, indicating a casual, informal style

worldview.power dynamics: believes in a hierarchy where he must assert himself to be recognized - manifests in his confrontational interactions with others
worldview.self-worth: values recognition and respect from peers - contrasts with a more humble character who seeks validation through teamwork

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a misunderstood hero trying to do the right thing
self_image_vs_reality.reality: reveals a deep-seated insecurity and a tendency to lash out when feeling threatened
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive and aggressive, often resorting to insults or threats

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses sarcasm and humor to deflect personal questions, maintaining a tough exterior
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes staccato and fragmented, revealing vulnerability
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: compresses speech to short, blunt statements, avoiding emotional depth
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks with confidence, using commanding language and assertive body language

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to banter to deflect tension, but may resort to aggression if that fails
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm and confrontational language, challenging their decisions
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely defensive, using aggressive speech to intimidate potential threats
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: often redirects the conversation or doubles down on his stance rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with sarcasm, escalates to confrontation if not taken seriously, and may resort to threats if provoked further

relationship_matrix.A-Train: competitive dynamic - seeks to undermine him while craving recognition
relationship_matrix.Homelander: subordinate dynamic - desires approval but fears his power
